name: Zwanzig ab
description: Zwanzig ab ('Twenty Off') is a German trick game. 2-4 players. 32-card Skat deck. 5 each (2+3). Start at 20pts, subtract 1 per trick won. First to 0 wins. Forehand chooses trumps. Can exchange up to 3 cards. May drop out (except trump chooser). Hearts trumps = double scoring.

history.origins: Zwanzig ab (Twenty Off) is a traditional German trick-taking game in the Rams group, played with a 32-card Skat pack. English-language rules trace to Ralf Brostedt's page; the game uses count-down scoring from 20 to zero and is popular in Germany.
timeline: Traditional German trick game; played with 32-card Skat deck and count-down scoring from 20 to 0.

setup.dealing: 5 each (2 then 3). Forehand picks trump from first 2.

rules.objective: Each player starts with a score of 20; the object is to be the first to reach zero.
rules.gameplay: Forehand chooses trump (from first 2 cards). Exchange up to 3. May drop out (not trump chooser). Follow suit, must trump if void. 1 trick = -1pt. All 5 = -5pts. 0 tricks while in = +5pts. Hearts = double. Diamonds = must stay.

variations.name: Jass trump order
variations.description: Some play with trump rank order J-9-A-10-K-Q-8-7 (Jass style) but A-10-K-Q-J-9-8-7 in plain suits.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Jass-style trump order is a regional variant; no engine overrides needed beyond existing trump config.

scoring.winCondition: First to reduce score from 20 to 0.
